title: [VIC] Felicity 5kW Solar Inverter + 25kWh Solar Battery for $3000, [NSW, QLD, SA, WA] from $3999 @ Solar Battery & Panel Group
body:
Deal: [VIC] Felicity 5kW Solar Inverter + 25kWh Solar Battery for $3000, [NSW, QLD, SA, WA] from $3999 @ Solar Battery & Panel Group

[solarbattery] Hi It's Facility Battery manufacturer promotion .
[loksmack] How much to upgrade to a 10kw inverter, with blackout protection?
[solarbattery] Hi 10kw inverter is $2000 more. Blackout protection is $350-$700 for single phase, and $500-$1000 for 3 phases.
You can email us Full address plus some meterbox and environment photos to check and confirm final cost : info@solarbattery.au
[Roe Jogan] ask them why nsw people have to get shafted?
[solarbattery] The shipment lands VIC port first. and then transport to other places costs more on shipping fee.
[tunzafun001] @solarbattery: Lucky Qld and WA is closer to Vic than NSW then….
[Roe Jogan] @tunzafun001: LMAO this, so WA has to pay 6000 by that logic, how does it make sense to charge same fee from vic to nsw vs vic to WA
[solarbattery] @Roe Jogan: WA transport & installer fees are actually also much more than everywhere else…But luckly WA rebates are also more than other places.
[solarbattery] @SetTheFaqUp: Yes, all these batteries are made in overseas. imported to Australia according to CEC approval regulation.
[tunzafun001] Can we get this without solar panels, concession holder (SA)?
If not, cheapest solar panel offering?
[solarbattery] solar panel is needed for this offer, 6.6kw solar panel is $4000 in SA.
You can email us Full address plus some meterbox and environment photos to check and confirm final cost : info@solarbattery.au
[solarbattery] VIC solar panel is also $4000 for 6.6kw solar panel
You can email us Full address plus some meterbox and environment photos to check and confirm final cost : info@solarbattery.au
[alvian] A reminder to read and follow our title guidelines. In particular, the basic requirement to include the name of the store.
[solarbattery] Sorry about that, and thank you for the update on title.
[shaidas] I would stay away from this brand. The warranty sounds dodgy
For the batteries (LUX-S, LUX-E, LUX-X, LUX-Y) branded with the FelicityESS
logo, the following policies are applicable:
⚫ In the first year, if there is an issue with the battery cells, they will be
directly replaced with new ones;
⚫ From the second to the seventh year, the Battery will be repaired first, and
if the repair is unsuccessful it will be replaced;
⚫ From the eighth to the tenth year, only free inspections are provided,
excluding labor charges and parts fees.
[hopper] How much extra for outside installation? 2m from switch box
[solarbattery] this one couldn't be installed outside. we have other brands like sofar battery 5kw inverter +25kwh battery $4499
[Seeyounexttuesday] Do you sell the batteries only? I already have 3p hybrid inverter. Whats the price for a FLH96050SG1?
[solarbattery] We sell battery for other brands, but in that case there would be no government rebates, price is pretty high.
